note: Canonical repository tree. scripts/verify-structure.mjs fails when a listed directory or root file is missing, so this file is the single machine readable statement of the structure defined in docs/final/STEP_PLAN_250.md.

directories.purpose: Next.js App Router entry point: root layout, root page, route groups and route handlers.
Public website, CMS pages, blog, legal pages and status page surfaces that need the public shell.
Signup, email verification, login, two factor authentication, password reset and login lock screens.
Merchant owner area: onboarding, underwriting, KYC, clients, products, invoices, estimates, payouts and settings.
Office dashboards for super_admin, ceo, compliance_kyc, finance_ops, support and blogger, plus platform settings screens.
Tokenized client surfaces under i/[token] and e/[token] with no login.

directories.owner: STEP 001 (health only), later STEPs own their handlers
directories.purpose: Route handlers. Each handler validates input, writes minimal rows and enqueues heavy work.

directories.owner: STEP 001 (root), later STEPs own their component folders
directories.purpose: Shared React components. Server Components by default, client components only where interaction requires it.
Typed application configuration, feature defaults, business limits and the canonical structure manifest.
Product documents, planning notes and step handoffs.

directories.owner: STEP 001 creates the folder, every STEP adds its own file
directories.purpose: One completed handoff file per finished STEP, copied from docs/final/HANDOFF_TEMPLATE.md.

directories.owner: STEP 001 (root), later STEPs own their libraries
directories.purpose: Foundation libraries: environment schema, configuration, i18n, logging, security, storage, payments, tax, email and API clients.

directories.owner: STEP 056 (input sanitiser for text, rich text and URLs)
directories.purpose: The one place that decides what a safe text, a safe URL and a safe rich text are: Unicode normalisation, character removal, the SSRF host rules, the URL and path decisions and the rich text allowlist.

directories.owner: STEP 012-036 and every STEP that adds a table
directories.purpose: Append-only numbered SQL migrations, each paired with a rollback file and never edited after commit.
Dependency free repository verification and maintenance scripts run through npm scripts.
Central design tokens. The single owner of colour, radius, elevation, typography and easing.

directories.owner: STEP 001 (root), later STEPs own their services
directories.purpose: Domain services that hold business rules: clients, products, invoices, payments, ledger, refunds, disputes, billing, support and company accounting.
